title: Senior React & Node Developer
descriptionText:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. Weve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

We are seeking a Senior React & Node Developer for our client. Its a SaaS platform for supplier intelligence and value-chain transparency, used by around 2,500 companies in 50+ countries. Youll work on their Business Partner Transparency product inside a serverless, enterprise-grade platform, building software that automates complex compliance workflows.

Involvement: full-time

Location: Madrid, on-site (hybrid). Relocation bonus is available. Only for candidates with EU citizenship or an equivalent right to work in Spain (visa sponsorship not available)

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience as a software developer
- 3+ years of experience with Node.js and React.js
- 3+ years of experience with TypeScript
- Familiarity with AI-assisted coding is a must
- Strong product mindset - proven in-house experience in product companies

- Clear and effective communication in English  advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.
- Adaptability and flexibility  the ability to onboard onto a project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React / TypeScript)
descriptionText:
At Infinitum Digital, we are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join a challenging technology project, developing scalable, reliable and high-performance digital solutions.

We are seeking a software engineer with strong frontend expertise, solid backend development skills and proven experience working with AWS in production environments.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, develop and maintain modern web applications using React, Next.js and TypeScript.

Develop and integrate backend services using Node.js/TypeScript or Java/Spring.

Work with AWS cloud infrastructure in production environments, including containerized or serverless architectures.

Contribute to software architecture, system design and technical decision-making.

Ensure high standards of code quality, maintainability, performance and scalability.

Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver reliable technical solutions.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience, excluding internships.

Senior-level expertise in React, Next.js and TypeScript.

Solid backend development experience with Node.js/TypeScript OR Java/Spring.

Proven hands-on experience with AWS in production environments, including containers or serverless technologies.

Strong understanding of software architecture, system design and engineering best practices.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Based in Barcelona or available to work in a hybrid model.
